G3201.def:
**μέμφομαι **
[in LXX: [[Sir.11.7; 41.7|Sir.11:7 41:7]], [[2Ma.2.7|2Ma.2:7]] * ;]
**to blame, find fault**: absol., [[Rom.9.19|Rom.9:19]] with accusative, αὐτούς (WH, txt.; αὐτούς, Rec., WH, mg.; on rendering with αὐτούς see Westc., in l), [[Heb.8.8|Heb.8:8]]†
(AS)

G3202.def:
**μεμψίμοιρος**, -ον
(μέμφομαι, + μοῖρα, fate, lot),
**complaining of one's fate, querulous**: [[Jude.16|Ju 16]] †
(AS)
